details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has outlined three crypto-focused rulemakings in its 2026 Unified Regulatory Agenda, with proposed rules expected as early as July. These initiatives aim to address crypto asset offerings, including potential exemptions and safe harbors, modify broker-dealer requirements for handling crypto assets (covering net capital, customer protection, and recordkeeping), and amend market structure rules for crypto trading on alternative trading systems (ATSs) and national securities exchanges. This move signals the SEC's intent to establish a more structured regulatory framework for the digital asset space.
title: SEC Adds 3 Crypto Rules to 2026 Regulatory Agenda

details: Bitcoin (BTC) is currently consolidating around $62,000, having recently rebounded from a low of $57,700. Despite some positive ETF flows, the broader market sentiment remains in "Extreme Fear," with the Fear & Greed Index fluctuating between 20 and 27 out of 100. The Coinbase Bitcoin Premium Index has recorded its longest negative streak at 50 consecutive days, suggesting persistent selling pressure from U.S. institutional investors. Historically, July has been a strong month for Bitcoin, even during bear market cycles, offering a potential bullish seasonal factor.
title: Bitcoin Hovers Around $62K Amidst Extreme Fear and Institutional Selling

details: Ethereum (ETH) is currently trading around $1,720, marking a significant 65% drop from its all-time high of $4,954. This price action occurs just weeks before the anticipated "Glamsterdam" upgrade, a major network overhaul expected to triple Ethereum's transaction capacity to 10,000 transactions per second and reduce transaction fees by up to 78%. Despite the price decline, on-chain data indicates that both retail and large holders are accumulating ETH, while mid-sized holders are responsible for most of the selling pressure. Prediction markets suggest a 57% probability of ETH reaching $1,900 in July.
title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Nears Amidst 65% Price Drop from ATH

details: Barely a week after the full implementation of its landmark Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) framework, European Union lawmakers are already discussing potential revisions and an expanded scope for crypto regulation. The European Commission has initiated a public consultation to gather feedback on whether areas such as decentralized finance (DeFi), crypto lending and borrowing, staking, and non-fungible tokens (NFTs) should be more explicitly included within the EU's regulatory purview. This ongoing evaluation highlights the regulators' focus on addressing emerging "regulatory gaps."
title: EU Explores Tighter Crypto Regulations, Expanding MiCA Scope

details: Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas has highlighted Vanguard's recent hiring of a 'Head of Digital Assets' as a significant development for the cryptocurrency industry. Vanguard, known for its cautious stance and being a prominent holdout on offering Bitcoin ETFs, is reportedly exploring blockchain technology for operational efficiencies and product innovation. This strategic move from one of the world's largest and most conservative asset managers suggests a growing mainstream acceptance of underlying blockchain infrastructure, and could influence broader institutional engagement with digital assets.
title: Vanguard Hires Digital Assets Head, Signaling Shift in Traditional Finance

details: The altcoin market is presenting a mixed picture, with some assets showing strong performance despite overall market caution. While Bitcoin and Ethereum have experienced some retracements, specific altcoins such as Zcash (ZEC) and Uniswap (UNI) have posted notable gains, indicating a rotation of capital into potentially undervalued assets. Analysts suggest that investors should be selective, prioritizing fundamentally strong projects. Key sectors currently highlighted for potential growth include artificial intelligence (AI), Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization, Decentralized Finance (DeFi), and Layer 1 blockchains.
title: Altcoins See Selective Rallies Amidst Broader Market Caution
